verdict.rationale: Unleash documents two native batch-style capabilities: export/import of feature flags for migration, and change requests that group multiple changes and apply them together at a set time. Both are thin mentions, and neither is a general bulk-edit feature (e.g. multi-select toggle, archive or tag across many flags). Segment reuse and the Admin API are adjacent or building blocks, so they get no credit. Missing for 10: documented bulk edit/toggle/archive across many flags in the UI or API, bulk operations exposed to AI agents via MCP, depth on export/import scope, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Export/import feature flags for easy migration
Change requests also allow you to group changes and apply them at a specific point in time.
